editorial.name: Fontshare
editorial.descriptionZh: Indian Type Foundry 的免费字体目录，现列约 100 个字族。全部可商用；Satoshi 等走 ITF Free Font License（闭源），另有字族为 SIL OFL 1.1。
editorial.takeawayZh: 下载 Satoshi，先核对其闭源许可
editorial.noteZh: 打开 fontshare.com，目录 100 个字族，Satoshi 标 10 styles Variable、Closed Source，Designed by Indian Type Foundry。About 写 free fonts service launched by ITF，100% free for personal and commercial use。Satoshi 字样页 Download Family，底栏 Closed Source。不能把整个目录当成单一 OFL。
editorial.pricing: Free for personal and commercial use; Satoshi is closed-source ITF FFL, other families may be OFL

reasons.statement: 首页把约 100 个字族铺成可筛选目录，Satoshi 等以 Closed Source 标签列出，主动作是预览并下载字体。
Satoshi 字样页给出 10 styles、Variable、Download Family，并标明 Designed By Indian Type Foundry 与 Closed Source。

facts.evidence: Satoshi 页写 Designed By Indian Type Foundry。About 写 Fontshare is a free fonts service launched by the Indian Type Foundry (ITF)。Satoshi 另由 Deni Anggara 设计，站内设计师字段显示为 ITF。
About 把 Fontshare 归为 ITF 推出的免费字体服务。许可证页写 parent company of Fontshare, the Indian Type Foundry (ITF)。

facts.value: not published as a public source repository
facts.evidence: About 与字样页均未给出 Fontshare 目录本身的公共源码仓库。闭源字族按 ITF FFL 分发，不能把 GitHub 目录树当作身份页。

facts.value: mixed: ITF Free Font License (closed source) and OFL-1.1
facts.evidence: Licenses 页写 Currently there are two types of free fonts: Closed Source governed by ITF’s Free Font License (FFL)，Open Source governed by SIL Open Font License (OFL)。Satoshi 字样页标 Closed Source / ITF Free Font License。不能把整个目录当成单一 OFL 或 MIT。

facts.value: Free for personal and commercial use; Satoshi is closed-source ITF FFL, other families may be OFL
facts.evidence: About 写 professional grade fonts that are 100% free for personal and commercial use。Closed Source 字族仍是专有免费软件，不是开源。

cautions: 许可不是通用宽松协议，逐条确认条款后再使用。mixed: ITF Free Font License (closed source) and OFL-1.1：Licenses 页写 Currently there are two types of free fonts: Closed Source governed by ITF’s Free Font License (FFL)，Open Source governed by SIL Open Font License (OFL)。Satoshi 字样页标 Closed Source / ITF Free Font License。不能把整个目录当成单一 OFL 或 MIT。
该条目登记了多个许可值（proprietary / OFL-1.1），目录之间可能不同，逐目录确认。
